page.overview:
What is Nírnaeth Arnoediad?

Glaurung, Gothmog, Ulfang †,unnamed others

Sons of Fëanor, Azaghâl †, Gwindor, Húrin, Huor †, Bór †, Círdan

The Nírnaeth Arnoediad, or Battle of Unnumbered Tears, was the fifth major battle in the War of the Great Jewels that took place in the late First Age and fought between the Union of Maedhros and Morgoth's forces. The battle was a pivotal moment in the war as the northern power of the Elves was effectively eliminated, allowing Morgoth to exercise his dominance over Beleriand.

Almost twenty years after the defeat of Elves and Edain in the Dagor Bragollach, the Ñoldor had lost control of the entire north of Beleriand, and held only the strongholds of Hithlum, Himring, and Nargothrond. Gondolin was still hidden and could not yet be assailed, yet could do little more than maintain its veil of secrecy. However, the deeds of Beren and Lúthien; defeating Sauron at Tol-in-Gaurhoth and retrieving a Silmaril from Angband, were spread far and wide in their aftermath. These tales convinced Maedhros that Morgoth was not invincible, and in the Year of the Sun 468, Maedhros conceived of an alliance that he believed capable of taking the war to Thangorodrim.
